# [v0.92.2][CF-INTEGRATE] Connect the complete installed CodeFriend Beta 1 journey

## Complete result and owned implementation

Connect the already complete CodeFriend consumers into one installed operator journey and pass integrated success/failure acceptance on an exact candidate. Own the new `adl/src/codefriend/integration.rs`, minimal wiring in `adl/src/cli/codefriend_cmd.rs`, focused `adl/tests/codefriend_integration.rs`, and its fixture/acceptance manifest. Re-resolve predecessor paths before editing; integrate existing APIs rather than rewriting their features. Record the installed candidate, schema/lane/provider versions and output manifest under the assigned issue's evidence directory.

## Acceptance

1. Reconcile every Beta exit-bar feature to a merged, reviewed, usable predecessor: setup, local/GitHub/CI ingestion, evidence safety, structure/drift/impact/rationale, local/CI fitness, four isolated perspectives, synthesis, both action planners, longitudinal comparison through Memory Palace, publication approval and all three renderers. An unfinished feature blocks integration; return it to its owner rather than absorbing its implementation.
2. Execute the installed complete journey from fresh setup and bounded input to actual provider-backed review, architecture/governance outputs, synthesis/plans, compatible second-run comparison and human-approved Markdown/HTML/PDF artifacts. Pin real registered model/profile and exact revisions before authorized provider use. Retain real input/output/provenance, no canned outputs.
3. Exercise provider failure, malformed/partial input, secret/provenance rejection, incomplete lane, incompatible/deleted baseline, cancellation/retry, stale or withheld approval and renderer failure. Failed stages remain explicit and cannot produce a successful manifest. Verify source immutability and no implicit external publication.
4. Run selected macOS/Linux installed success/failure checks and distinguish actual CI evidence from local proof. Confirm every exit-bar row has nonzero executed evidence and residual-risk disposition; no unresolved P1 or unowned failure. Missing proof leaves this issue incomplete.
5. Deliver one exact installed candidate to CF-PROOF for independent qualification; CF-INTEGRATE never depends on CF-PROOF. OBS-S3 and ARCH-ADR do not gate this issue or TAIL-01; their accepted results gate TAIL-10. This integration is not the independent qualification or release decision.

## PVF

Deterministic local integration/failure fixtures with isolated stores and controlled transport plus separately identified real registered-provider journey and macOS/Linux CI evidence; bounded CPU/disk/process/model limits pinned before effects. Role: end-to-end wiring and failure propagation; required Beta candidate gate. No green component-only CI, schema or authored evidence packet substitutes for actual product execution.

## Startup, dependencies and scope authority

The operator's global startup gate applies: **all 69 issue identities must be created and all batch reviews must pass before any implementation starts**. Creation/review batching adds no execution dependency edges. After that gate, each task still requires its own exact prerequisites, native readiness, bound FastWork ownership and issue-bound goal; root main remains inspection-only. Issue creation does not authorize paid/provider/cloud operations, external messages, public publication, writer activation or a successor milestone. Use explicit existing scope authority for those effects.

Canonical sources: `docs/milestones/v0.92.2/WP_ISSUE_WAVE_v0.92.2.yaml`, `WP_EXECUTION_SPECIFICATIONS_v0.92.2.yaml`, `ATOMIC_TASK_CONTRACTS_v0.92.2.json`, `CREATION_SELECTIONS_v0.92.2.md`, `RELEASE_PLAN_v0.92.2.md`, `QUALITY_GATE_v0.92.2.md`, `MILESTONE_CHECKLIST_v0.92.2.md` and `NEXT_MILESTONE_HANDOFF_v0.92.2.md`. Re-resolve exact candidate and existing ownership before acting. Preserve canonical TAIL-01 through TAIL-10 order and all seven planning tasks. Each issue delivers its one complete named result; supporting code/docs/proof are part of that result, not unrelated work.

New tests declare lane, role, determinism, resources and gate in the coupled proof manifest. Preserve redacted stderr diagnostics and machine-readable stdout, immutable evidence and private-source boundaries. Independent exact-head review and required checks precede publication; distinguish local validation, CI, actual execution, human approval and terminal reconciliation. Missing proof/authority, stale identity or conflicting ownership stops dependent action with durable evidence; do not retry around guards.

## Canonical obligation ledger

Dependencies: CF-SHELL, CF-ADAPTER, CF-ADAPTER-GITHUB, CF-ADAPTER-CI, CF-EVIDENCE, CF-COG, CF-COG-DRIFT, CF-COG-IMPACT, CF-COG-RATIONALE, CF-GOV, CF-GOV-CI, CF-REVIEW, CF-SYNTHESIS, CF-REMEDIATE, CF-TESTPLAN, CF-MEMORY, CF-UX, CF-RENDER-MD, CF-RENDER-HTML, CF-RENDER-PDF, PLAT-PROVIDER, RT-PROVIDER, PLAT-MEMORY. Existing canonical mappings include WP-01/#864, RT-PROVIDER/#855 and SIM-UMBRELLA/#866; resolve remaining logical IDs from the verified creation map, never infer numbers.

# [v0.92.2][CF-PROOF] Execute independent installed Beta 1 qualification on ADL and an external repository

## Complete result and owned qualification

Independently execute a repeatable installed-product qualification against the exact CF-INTEGRATE candidate on ADL and the selected external repository. Own proposed `adl/tools/qualify_codefriend_beta1.py`, its focused harness checks and issue-local scenario/result manifests. Consume installed product commands without reimplementing them; fix product defects in their responsible upstream issues, then refresh candidate and affected qualification.

## Acceptance

1. A reviewer independent of the integrated implementation follows complete fresh-operator documentation and installs the candidate on selected macOS/Linux environments. Execute the actual setup → ingestion → review/analysis → synthesis/action plans → comparison → approved Markdown/HTML/PDF journey on both ADL and the pinned external scope. Retain source/binary/environment/provider/model/profile identities, all commands, actual generated artifacts, failures and nonzero scenario counts.
2. Vector is fixed at `410da89a0ed42c523143da89fffeb7f6402833e0`, exactly the seven dnsmsg-parser files plus root Cargo.toml/Cargo.lock/LICENSE in CREATION_SELECTIONS: ten files, 600 KiB total, 400 KiB per file. Preserve MIT crate/MPL-2.0 root notices; no builds/scripts/dependency downloads or whole-repository analysis claim. Pin the ADL source and bounded scope too. A changed-source comparison fixture has an explicitly separate controlled revision, never a silently changed external pin.
3. Use the selected shared registered OpenAI Responses route with approved credential reference, exact execution model/profile, resource/time/token bounds and separate paid/live authority. Require actual nonzero generated review, not configured-but-unused provider or synthetic-only acceptance.
4. Execute repeat compatible second runs plus missing/incompatible/deleted baseline negatives; show honest partial/incomplete runs, provider failure, privacy/tampering denial, unapproved/stale artifact rejection and renderer failures. Inspect actual HTML navigation and rendered PDF pages and check all three semantic claim sets against approved inputs.
5. Complete docs/examples/reproduction instructions and independent privacy/nonclaim audit. Evidence references must resolve to the exact candidate; authored packets without executed producers are rejected. Report pass/fail/not-proven per exit-bar cell. Unlicensed/changed fixture, privacy leak, unexecuted scenario or unavailable real-provider authority leaves qualification incomplete rather than downgraded to fixture proof.
6. Hand TAIL-01 the independently reviewed accepted evidence for both repositories and all supported environments. This does not certify the repositories defect-free, customer-scale coverage, public benchmark superiority or release approval.

## PVF

Deterministic local harness/contract negatives plus observed actual product/provider/browser/PDF qualification, bounded CPU/disk and explicitly authorized model execution. Role: independent installed-candidate acceptance; required TAIL-01 input. Preserve local-versus-CI distinction, nonzero denominators and exact source/output manifests; runtime outcomes are observed, not declared deterministic because the harness is reproducible.
